chunks: And in the narration of Ḥarīz, he said: Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said:
"There is no harm in the canopy over women and children while they are muhrim. And the muhrim must not immerse himself in water, nor the fasting person."

key_terms.مُحْرِمُونَ: those in the state of ihram
key_terms.يَرْتَمِسُ: to immerse oneself fully in water

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for women and children in ihram to be under a canopy, and may a muhrim or fasting person immerse in water?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning those in ihram and those observing sawm. It permits the use of a canopy for women and children in ihram, while prohibiting immersion in water for the muhrim and for the fasting person.
